structure.unit: Boundary Adjustments and Changes of Status of Counties, Cities and Towns

law.catch_line: Chapter not applicable to cities already existing
law.text: This chapter shall not affect the organization, government, officers, charter or laws governing any city declared to be such prior to January 1, 1976, under former acts of the General Assembly. Statutes under which cities declared to be such prior to January 1, 1976, were organized as cities shall continue in force.
